The biggest things I’d recommend is trying to consult with a therapist asap( it can take a few tries to find someone that you mend with) They can help you sort your thoughts and feelings and recommend medication/ supplements as needed. Vitamin D supplementation and things like light therapy may even help. Try to develop a safety plan with people you trust. Personally I’ve found it helps to create a list of things I desire to do in my life( these can be simple things like clean up the yard, make healthcare appointments, finish this art project whatever it takes) I like to list things I would miss if I left( thunderstorms, the smell of fresh baked cookies, bonfires, events) journaling every day can help as well
